Step 6: Put all fatigued winner ads into that ad set by post ID and add a cost per result goal on the ad set level

Step 7: Let it spend. If the ad set hits KPI afte rspending 3x-5x your target cost per call, cool! If not turn off some ads that are getting spend and no results in there.

Step 8: Launch new graveyard ad sets over time

Step-by-step guide 👇

Alright, so you want to make 10k/mo, 20k/mo, whatever online right?

It comes down to your ability to do 3 things, and 2 of these points are directly from Naval Ravikant himself. 

Let’s break them down 👇

1️⃣ CREATE FOCUS

There is literally no way to grow something massive if you spread your focus too thin. 

Mark Zuckerberg didn’t have a “side hustle” while creative Facebook. He had one focus and ruthlessly cut everything else out. 

Find out what you’re actually good at, don’t fully hate doing, and go all in on it. Go deep in its subject matter. 

Become an expert. 

And most importantly, don’t chase shiny objects especially when the “honeymoon phase” wears off and things get hard.

2️⃣ CREATE LEVERAGE

Naval talks about creating leverage a lot within your business to scale quicker. Try this:

Set your “hourly wage” at something high like $$500-$1,000+ an hour. If you can outsource something that isn’t revenue producing for LESS than that number, do it.

Outsource admin tasks, pipeline management, copywriting, editing, etc. Any task that you can outsource that isn’t directly producing new revenue for LESS than your pre-set hourly wage, and especially things that you hate doing… hire someone for it.

Create leverage. This sort of ties into the point on focus too. You want to focus on the most important tasks that drive your business forward. Cut anything else out or outsource it.
